title: 2. Urban Challenge Track Mapping
label: TRACK FIT
kicker: Lead with Transformational Technology, then use the same district-scoring scaffold for Prosperous People and targeted extension tracks.

cards.title: Transformational Technology
cards.body: Use mobility layers, route visibility, fallback-aware data, APIs, and Azure deployment to prove a working urban intelligence path.

cards.title: Prosperous People
cards.body: Convert the district score into service access, walkability, 15-minute city coverage, or quality-of-life comparison.

cards.title: Builder pitch
cards.body: Show a credible local app first, then explain how the same scaffold can support richer district intelligence.

cards.title: Sustainable Solutions
cards.body: Add AQI, heat, emissions, low-carbon route scoring, and clean-corridor recommendations after the core map works.

cards.title: Culture
cards.body: Add heritage sites, event-day routing, visitor flows, multilingual notes, and crowd-sensitive access planning.

cards.title: What to keep
cards.body: Keep the frontend shell, FastAPI contracts, sample fallback, score panel, and Azure deployment shape.

cards.title: Maps
cards.body: Azure Maps supports the cloud map path once keys are configured.

cards.title: Data
cards.body: Blob Storage and Cosmos DB support processed files and app-shaped records.

cards.title: Runtime
cards.body: Container Apps, App Insights, and Log Analytics make the prototype deployable and observable.

callout: Positioning rule: do not sell this as a final transport model. Sell it as a credible build path for urban intelligence prototypes.
